109	-- Returns the career page config + published jobs for a given slug.
110	-- SECURITY DEFINER so it can bypass RLS to read jobs/config
111	-- for the unauthenticated public careers page.
112	-- search_path is pinned to prevent search_path injection.
113	
114	CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_career_page(p_slug text)
115	RETURNS jsonb
116	LANGUAGE plpgsql
117	SECURITY DEFINER
118	STABLE
119	SET search_path = public
120	AS $$
121	DECLARE
122	  _config record;
123	  _jobs   jsonb;
124	BEGIN
125	  -- Fetch career page config (active only — public endpoint)
126	  SELECT id, team_id, slug, company_name, logo_url, brand_color, tagline, about
127	  INTO   _config
128	  FROM   public.career_page_config
129	  WHERE  slug = p_slug
130	    AND  is_active = true;
131	
132	  IF NOT FOUND THEN
133	    RETURN NULL;
134	  END IF;
135	
136	  -- Fetch published, non-failed jobs for this team
137	  SELECT COALESCE(
138	    jsonb_agg(
139	      jsonb_build_object(
140	        'id',              j.id,
141	        'title',           j.title,
142	        'location',        j.location,
143	        'department',      j.department,
144	        'employment_type', j.employment_type,
145	        'salary_range',    j.salary_range,
146	        'created_at',      j.created_at
147	      ) ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
148	    ),
149	    '[]'::jsonb
150	  )
151	  INTO _jobs
152	  FROM public.jobs j
153	  WHERE j.team_id     = _config.team_id
154	    AND j.is_published = true
155	    AND j.status      != 'failed';
156	
157	  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
158	    'config', jsonb_build_object(
159	      'company_name', _config.company_name,
160	      'logo_url',     _config.logo_url,
161	      'brand_color',  _config.brand_color,
162	      'tagline',      _config.tagline,
163	      'about',        _config.about
164	    ),
165	    'jobs', _jobs
166	  );
167	END;
168	$$;

## DEEP AUDIT: RANKORA CAREER PAGE SYSTEM

### 1. CURRENT FEATURES

**What the Career Page Shows:**
- Branded header with company logo and name
- Sticky header with navigation
- Hero section with:
  - Large company name display
  - Optional tagline
  - Optional about/company description (plaintext only, max 2000 chars)
  - Badge showing total open positions count
- Search functionality across job titles, departments, and locations
- Multi-filter system:
  - Department filter (dynamic from job data, appears only if >1 department)
  - Location filter (dynamic from job data, appears only if >1 location)
- Job listing cards displaying:
  - Job title
  - Location, Department, Employment Type, Salary Range (with icons)
  - "Posted X days ago" timestamp
  - Social sharing buttons (LinkedIn, X/Twitter, copy link)
  - "Apply Now" button (styled with brand color)
- Empty state messaging when no positions match filters
- Footer with Rankora attribution and legal disclaimer

**What Settings Are Configurable:**
- Company name
- URL slug (auto-generated from company name, with availability checking)
- Logo URL (external image link)
- Brand color (6-digit hex only, no shortcuts like #fff)
- Tagline (max 160 chars)
- About/company description (max 2000 chars, plaintext)
- Is Active toggle (controls public visibility)
- Per-job publishing toggle (which jobs appear on career page)
- Career page URL preview (copy and open links)

---

### 2. DATABASE SCHEMA

**career_page_config Table:**
```
- id (UUID, PK)
- team_id (UUID, UNIQUE, FK to teams table, CASCADE delete)
- slug (TEXT, UNIQUE, validated: ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9\-]{1,58}[a-z0-9]$)
- company_name (TEXT, NOT NULL)
- logo_url (TEXT, nullable)
- brand_color (TEXT, DEFAULT '#6366f1', validated: ^#[0-9a-fA-F]{6}$)
- tagline (TEXT, nullable, max 160 chars)
- about (TEXT, nullable, max 2000 chars)
- is_active (BOOLEAN, DEFAULT false)
- created_at, updated_at (TIMESTAMPTZ)
```

**Jobs Table Extensions:**
```
Added 5 new columns to jobs table:
- location (TEXT, nullable)
- department (TEXT, nullable)
- employment_type (TEXT, DEFAULT 'Full-time')
- salary_range (TEXT, nullable)
- is_published (BOOLEAN, DEFAULT false)
```

**Job Fields Available:**
The public career page shows: title, location, department, employment_type, salary_range, created_at

The admin JobMetadataSection in JobDetailView allows editing:
- Location (freetext, e.g. "San Francisco, CA")
- Department (freetext, e.g. "Engineering")
- Employment Type (SELECT: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Internship, Freelance)
- Salary Range (freetext, e.g. "$80k - $120k")

**Existing Job Fields (from broader system):**
- id, user_id, team_id, title, job_description, status, is_published
- must_weight, nice_weight, optional_weight (for ranking)
- jd_analysis_json, dynamic_weights_json, jd_embedding (for AI)
- processing_started_at, completed_at (lifecycle)

---

### 3. JOB METADATA FIELDS

Currently available job metadata fields on the public page:

| Field | Type | Source | Visibility |
|-------|------|--------|------------|
| title | string | jobs.title | Public |
| location | string | jobs.location | Public |
| department | string | jobs.department | Public |
| employment_type | string | jobs.employment_type | Public |
| salary_range | string | jobs.salary_range | Public |
| created_at | timestamp | jobs.created_at | Public (formatted as "Posted X days ago") |

All are **optional** fields (nullable in database except employment_type which defaults to "Full-time").

---

### 4. MISSING PRODUCTION FEATURES

#### **SEO & Meta Tags**
- No `<head>` meta tags per page (og:title, og:description, og:image, etc.)
- No canonical URLs set
- No structured schema markup (JSON-LD for JobPosting)
- No meta description per job or per page
- Page title is static: `Careers at {company_name} | Rankora` (no per-job titles)
- No robots.txt or sitemap generation

#### **Custom Branding & Styling**
- Only logo URL and one brand color supported (very limited)
- No custom CSS injection capability
- No font family customization
- No custom footer/header HTML
- No custom domain support (locked to /careers/:slug on Rankora domain)
- No dark mode toggle (uses system theme only)
- No page-wide styling options (padding, border radius, spacing)

#### **Job Listing Filtering & Discovery**
- No job categories beyond department/location
- No job type tags beyond the hardcoded employment_type field
- No skill-based filtering
- No experience level filtering
- No salary filtering/ranges
- No date range filtering for posted jobs

#### **Search & Navigation**
- Search is basic substring matching only
- No search analytics (what candidates search for)
- No featured/promoted jobs
- No job recommendations
- No breadcrumb navigation
- No related jobs suggestions

#### **Social & Sharing**
- Social buttons present but minimal (LinkedIn, X, copy link only)
- No Facebook/email sharing
- No Pinterest
- No hashtag suggestions
- No pre-filled share text optimization

#### **Analytics & Tracking**
- No view tracking per job
- No application count tracking
- No click-through tracking
- No Google Analytics integration
- No conversion tracking
- No A/B testing capability
- No traffic source attribution
- No bounce rate/time-on-page metrics

#### **Application Tracking**
- No views counter on job listings
- No application counter
- No "hot job" indicators (popular jobs)
- No weekly/monthly application trends
- No per-candidate source tracking (where they came from)

#### **Rich Content**
- Job descriptions are plaintext only in job_description field
- No markdown support
- No HTML formatting
- No embedded videos
- No image galleries
- No benefits/perks display fields
- No team member profiles linked to jobs

#### **Job Lifecycle Management**
- No job expiry dates/auto-closure
- No job status indicators (new, closing soon, filled)
- No "applications closing soon" warnings
- No job renewal/refresh timestamps
- No archived jobs view
- No draft jobs (only publish/unpublish toggle)
- No scheduling jobs for future publication

#### **Email & Notifications**
- No email alerts for new jobs
- No job subscription/watchlist
- No email to candidate when you apply
- No "new matching jobs" alerts
- No weekly job digest
- No SMS notifications

#### **Advanced Configuration**
- No multi-language support (slug language varies, content doesn't)
- No timezone considerations
- No custom email domain for reply-to
- No GDPR/compliance fields (privacy policy acceptance, etc.)
- No integration with ATS systems
- No Zapier/webhook integration
- No career page analytics dashboard

#### **Mobile & UX**
- Layout appears responsive but not explicitly tested
- No mobile-specific optimizations mentioned
- No progressive web app (PWA) capability
- No offline view
- No job alerts/notifications push capability
- No resume quick-upload on mobile

#### **Accessibility**
- No ARIA labels beyond minimal
- No keyboard navigation enhancements shown
- No color contrast checker integration
- No screen reader testing mentioned

---

### 5. SETTINGS COMPLETENESS

**What Recruiters CAN Customize:**
✅ Company branding (name, logo URL, one color)  
✅ Career page slug/URL  
✅ Tagline & about section  
✅ Activate/deactivate entire career page  
✅ Toggle which jobs are published (on/off per job)  
✅ Set job metadata (location, department, employment type, salary)  
✅ View live career page URL  
✅ Slug availability checking  

**What Recruiters CANNOT Customize:**
❌ Custom CSS/HTML for page  
❌ Supported fields beyond location, department, employment_type, salary  
❌ Email templates or reply-to addresses  
❌ Job categories/tags (beyond department)  
❌ Application form fields (these are per-job but not visible in Career Settings)  
❌ Analytics dashboard  
❌ Application notifications  
❌ Job expiry dates  
❌ Featured/sponsored jobs  
❌ Custom domain  
❌ Visibility to specific teams/accounts  

**Missing Settings Pages:**
- No analytics dashboard
- No application management integration
- No email notification settings
- No social share customization
- No SEO settings per page
- No advanced job metadata fields (benefits, perks, team size, salary history, etc.)

---

### 6. PUBLIC PAGE QUALITY

**Strengths:**
- Clean, modern design with good use of whitespace
- Responsive layout (mobile-first approach visible)
- Smooth interactions (hover effects, transitions)
- Good accessibility structure (semantic HTML, icon + text combinations)
- Professional footer with legal disclaimer
- Smart filtering (only shows filters when relevant)
- Good visual hierarchy
- Social sharing integrated
- Fast load times (uses React Query caching, 60-second stale time)
- Branded colors respected throughout

**Weaknesses & Gaps:**
- Very basic (looks more like a prototype than production career page)
- No rich job descriptions visible on listing page
- No featured section or job spotlight
- No candidate testimonials
- No company culture content
- No team member profiles
- No benefits/perks display
- No application success stories
- No "Why join us" section beyond one about field
- No job detail page (only apply modal routing)
- No SEO for individual jobs
- No engagement metrics ("X+ applications this week")
- Social sharing buttons are subtle/hard to notice
- No "recent applications" or "apply before Friday" urgency signals
- No video/media in career page
- No candidate reviews (Glassdoor-style)
- Not production-grade from an HR perspective

**UX Gaps:**
- No breadcrumb navigation
- Search doesn't show "no results found" messaging for bad matches clearly
- Filters reset when you navigate away
- No "save job" or favorites functionality
- No job email alert signup
- No back button if coming from external link
- No related/similar jobs suggestions after applying
- Filter pills could show active count
- No salary range search (just hardcoded location/department)

---

### 7. SECURITY & RLS NOTES

**Good:**
- RLS properly configured on career_page_config table
- Career page config visible to:
  - Unauthenticated users if is_active = true (via get_career_page RPC)
  - Team admins always (for settings)
- Jobs UPDATE policy fixed (migration 20260408000000) to allow team members to toggle is_published
- SECURITY DEFINER on get_career_page RPC with pinned search_path
- Slug availability check properly gated to authenticated users only
- UNIQUE constraint on (team_id, slug) prevents duplicates

**Issues Fixed by RLS Migration:**
The 20260408000000 migration fixed a critical bug where only job owners (user_id = auth.uid()) could update jobs, preventing team members from toggling is_published on the career page. Now any team member can update their team's jobs.
